title: Heated Humidifier Sold with an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit
content:
# Heated Humidifier Sold with an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit

**Bundle price card.** The heated humidifier furnished with a PAP Therapy Equipment unit that the patient buys outright where it stands in the home is sold with it:

| Humidifier furnished with the unit | Patient's active PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment shows the humidifier in use | Humidifier amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 79.00 |
| yes | no, or no active enrollment | 39.50 |
| no | any | 0.00 |

The humidifier amount is added on top of the price charged for the unit itself, and the sale amount is that total, rounded half up to the cent.

**Where it is read.** "Furnished with a humidifier" is the humidifier-included indicator on the PAP Therapy Equipment device record; "in use" is the humidifier-in-use indicator on the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment in status active.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Unit price 811.35, humidifier furnished, active enrollment shows it in use: sale amount 811.35 plus 79.00, or 890.35. The same unit with the enrollment showing the humidifier not in use: 811.35 plus 39.50, or 850.85.
